units.source_text: 那尼姑伸手摸摸她的头发，说：“梳也懒得梳，却长得一头好头发！

en.t: The nun reached out and stroked her hair, saying, "You are too lazy even to comb it, yet you have such beautiful hair!

units.source_text: 只是太孩子气，真教我担心。

en.t: But you are far too childish, and it truly worries me.

units.source_text: 像你这样的年纪，应该懂事了。

en.t: At your age, you ought to understand things by now.

units.source_text: 你那死了的妈妈十二岁上失去父亲，这时候她什么都懂得了。

en.t: Your late mother lost her father when she was twelve, and by then she understood everything.

units.source_text: 像你这样的人，我死之后怎样过日子呢？”

en.t: How will someone like you manage to live after I am gone?"
After saying this, she began to weep sorrowfully.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看着，也觉得伤心。

en.t: Prince Genji watched this and felt saddened too.

units.source_text: 女孩虽然年幼无知，这时候也抬起头来，悲哀地向尼姑注视。

en.t: Though the girl was still young and innocent, she raised her head then and looked sorrowfully at the nun.

units.source_text: 后来垂下眼睛，低头默坐。

en.t: Then she lowered her eyes, bowed her head, and sat silently.

units.source_text: 铺在额上的头发光彩艳丽，非常可爱。

en.t: The hair spread across her forehead shone beautifully and was very lovely.
